mutations.verdict: red on all four, and both halves of the check reddened: the behavioural one named the ticks on which a blow landed with a frozen stream, and the metadata one named the field.

mutations.criterion: #361 criterion 3 — a different shape of the same defect, to show the behavioural half is not a paraphrase of the declaration
mutations.why: A defensive copy written by hand instead of by the compiler. The field stays declared without `readonly`, so the shape the metadata check looks for is absent and it has nothing to find — but the stream is frozen exactly as before. This is the realistic way the defect comes back once the declaration is right, and it is the reason the check does not consist of the metadata half alone.
